description: Defines the BasketItem entity class within the application core, representing an item in a shopping basket with properties and methods to manipulate quantities.

classes.name: BasketItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the shopping basket, including properties for price, quantity, and identifiers, with methods to modify its state.

methods.name: BasketItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a basket item with a catalog item ID, quantity, and unit price.

methods.name: AddQuantity
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity to the existing basket item after validating the input.

methods.name: SetQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the basket item to a specific value after validation.
